tests.name: Pointer input respects every numeric range and step
Choice dragging clamps both ends without wrapping apparatus
Both sides of the beam snap to numbered positions
Spring endpoint uses extension from the initial mark
Cart dragging changes applied force and direction, retaining mass
Drop zones accept nearby placements and reject distant releases
Planar force endpoint changes both magnitude and angle
Lowering weights gives the selected submerged volume at a fixed surface
Empty apparatus and removal instructions describe the actual action
Pointer and keyboard provenance survives record export and restoration
Malformed or unbounded manipulation records are rejected
